input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, perfectly upright typewriter-style serif letters, never italic, never slanted, never redrawn, never morphing. Her face stays exactly the same person as in the first frame in every frame: same eyes, same eyebrows, same nose, same lips, same face shape, same bangs; her identity never changes. A calm young Japanese woman with a black bob haircut at a warm whisky bar holds a whisky glass on the rocks beside her chest. She slowly and gently lifts the glass a little toward the camera in a quiet toast and says softly in a calm, gentle, warm female voice in Japanese: 「乾杯。」 Her lips move in sync. Then she keeps looking at the camera with a soft, gentle, closed-mouth smile. The ice in the glass clinks softly. Very small, slow movements only; her other arm, her shoulders, chest and T-shirt stay still, and the glass and her hand never cover the print. Audio: only her voice, the soft clink of ice and a very faint quiet bar ambience, no music, no other voices. Warm bokeh lights glimmer softly in the background. Avoid: zoom, zooming in, zooming out, camera push-in, dolly, pan, tilt, camera shake, garbled text, changing letters, misspelled words, nonsense text, extra text, new text, morphing print, print redrawing, italic letters, slanted letters, warped logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, face morphing, identity change, different person, teeth distortion, flicker, watermark, captions, subtitles, big smile, laughing, teeth, exaggerated expression, raising the glass high, fast movement, glass covering the print, spilling, music, singing, English speech, extra words
